newsitem.title: USA: La Quinta Inns files SEC shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: La Quinta Inns files SEC shelf registration.

text.p: La Quinta Inns Inc said Friday it has filed a shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission which would allow the company to issue up to $300 million principal amount of debt securities.
The securities may be offered from time to time in one or more series, in amounts, at prices and on terms to be determined at the time of the offering or offerings, it noted.

La Quinta said the proceeds from the sale of the debt would be used for general corporate purposes, which might include additions of new inns, expansion and improvement of existing properties, repayment of indebtedness and repurchase of securities or for such other purposes as may be specified from time to time in a prospectus supplement.
